claims.text: Node drain started for a kernel upgrade on 2025-10-21 02:10.
The cache pod was evicted and orders-api logged connection refused errors for cache:6379.
The cache pod was found stuck in Pending with its volume bound to the drained node.
The node was brought back in the cluster at 2025-10-21 02:33, and the cache statefulset was restarted.
Latency returned to normal at 2025-10-21 02:36 and the incident was closed.
The cache pod was evicted during a node drain and did not come back on its own.
orders-api fell back to the database for every read, and checkout p95 latency rose to 2.8 seconds for 22 minutes.
The incident started at 2025-10-21 02:14 UTC and lasted for 22 minutes.
The cache ran as a single pod with no PodDisruptionBudget, so a planned drain took it down.
The cache volume was bound to one node, so the pod could not move to another node.
